estilo: Documentary photo, soft natural daylight, Brazilian home garden, realistic colors, sharp focus, no text, no logos

fotos.cena: Close-up of a man's hands measuring a small raw unpainted wooden board, about 10 to 15 cm wide, with a tape measure on a garden workbench
Close-up of a man's hands fixing a low 3 cm raw wooden rim around the edges of a small square wooden tray

Close-up of a man's hands fixing a small raw wooden nesting tray to a garden wall about one meter above the ground, half hidden behind the leaves of a climbing plant; the small mascot figurine sits on the edge of the wooden tray
Soft loose plastic netting carelessly draped over a fruiting shrub in a home garden, with saggy folds and loose ends hanging, no birds
Dry sunflower head full of ripe seeds, still on the plant in the garden; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil at the foot of the sunflower stem
Pyracantha shrub with thorny branches loaded with clusters of bright orange berries
Cotoneaster covering a low garden wall with small leaves and many tiny red berries
Black nightshade plant (Solanum americanum) with small white flowers and clusters of ripe shiny black berries
Close-up of a man's hands gently unwrapping a young grafted rose plant from its packaging, without pulling or twisting it
Close-up of a man's hands planting a young climbing rose in the soil about 30 cm from the foot of a metal garden arch; the small mascot figurine stands on the soil next to the arch post
Close-up of a man's hands leaning a newly planted climbing rose at a 45 degree angle toward a metal garden arch
Old weak rose bush with few leaves and thin stems in a tired old garden bed
Rosa rugosa hedge with wrinkled leaves and pink single flowers along a roadside edge
Yellow Lady Banks rose, almost thornless, covering a garden fence with clusters of small double yellow flowers
Ballerina shrub rose in a garden bed covered in small single pink flowers with white centers; the small mascot figurine stands on the garden path next to it
Huge Rosa filipes climbing rose grown up into a tall tree shape, covered in clusters of small white flowers
Close-up of a man's hands stripping the leaves from a straight young fig branch to leave about 30 cm of clean stem
